title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.01 (versions follow prime numbers; 101 after 97): her cells talk. Until now a cell (a gear of code expressed in a tissue of Luma) acted alone. Now each of her two cabins has a common medium where every tissue has a word. A cell says only the difference it made in its tissue, signed with whose it is; when a cell is said it hears what the others said that it had not heard yet (one number: all that was said, less what its own tissue said, less what it already heard), passes it through its own gear and adds it to its tissue; what that changed is its echo, said in turn. A hole is silence. The tissue numbers that were free now carry the signal. Measured with a known answer on the New Testament: a cell that moves the eye and a cell that only listens read exactly as the two letters of her alphabet that do that by hand (both -6478), and a signal relayed by a free tissue reads as the letter it should (3935); every earlier measurement is identical, since a lone cell hears nobody. Stated limits: in her body it runs but has no known-answer test yet; her two cabins do not talk to each other; a tissue listens only through its cells; no talking recipe improves the champion, and no cell of hers has won yet. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.01: sus células se hablan — cada una dice sólo la diferencia que hizo, firmada; las otras la oyen por su propio engranaje y su eco vuelve. Prototipo de investigación.
